title: Three programs, one job each
description: TrenchBroom is the editor. Morrobroom is the compiler. OpenMW is where you play the result.

nodes.title: TrenchBroom
nodes.detail: Build rooms from brushes, place lights and objects, and save the .map.

nodes.title: Morrobroom
nodes.detail: Compile the saved map into NIF meshes, baked lightmaps and a TES3 plugin.

nodes.title: OpenMW
nodes.detail: Load the build folder as data and walk around what you made.

nodes.title: Existing NIFs
nodes.detail: nif2map reverse-compiles their visual geometry into maps you can edit.
